items.title: 美伊暂停攻击致油价大跌，双方停止打击
items.original_title: Oil price dives as US and Iran pause attacks
items.summary_zh: 美国表示已暂停对伊朗的攻击，以“给谈判留出空间”，引发对冲突解决的希望。此举导致油价大幅下跌。
items.summary_en: The US says attacks on Iran have been halted to give 'talks some space', raising hopes of a resolution to the conflict, causing oil prices to dive.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 美伊冲突的暂停直接影响全球能源市场和地缘政治稳定。
items.why_it_matters_en: The pause in US-Iran attacks directly impacts global energy markets and geopolitical stability.

items.title: 英国首相承诺继续支持乌克兰，泽连斯基将访英
items.original_title: UK PM pledges continued support for Ukraine ahead of Zelensky visit
items.summary_zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基将成为英国新首相上任后首位国际访客，英国首相承诺继续支持乌克兰。
items.summary_en: Ukrainian President Zelensky will be the new UK prime minister's first international visitor; the UK PM pledges continued support for Ukraine.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 英国新政府对乌政策延续性对俄乌战争走向有重要影响。
items.why_it_matters_en: Continuity of UK policy on Ukraine is crucial for the course of the Russia-Ukraine war.

items.title: 柏林骄傲节袭击嫌疑人被警方击毙
items.original_title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed during police operation
items.summary_zh: 警方称阿卜杜勒·巴卢特在柏林西部持刀冲向警员时被击毙。此事件被定性为疑似伊斯兰恐怖主义行为。
items.summary_en: Police say Abdul Ballout was shot and killed after he rushed at officers with a knife in a western borough of Berlin. The attack is being treated as a likely act of Islamist terrorism.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该事件凸显欧洲本土恐怖主义威胁，并引发对 LGBTQ+ 群体安全感的担忧。
items.why_it_matters_en: The incident highlights the threat of domestic terrorism in Europe and raises concerns about the safety of the LGBTQ+ community.

items.title: 内塔尼亚胡指责纽约市长“煽动仇恨”，此前市长威胁逮捕他
items.original_title: Netanyahu accuses NYC Mayor Mamdani of 'fomenting hate' after arrest threat
items.summary_zh: 纽约市长马姆达尼上周收回威胁，承认没有法律权力执行国际刑事法院对内塔尼亚胡的逮捕令。内塔尼亚胡指责其“煽动仇恨”。
items.summary_en: Mamdani walked back his threat last week, acknowledging he lacked the legal power to arrest Netanyahu on an ICC warrant. Netanyahu accused him of 'fomenting hate'.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 此事件涉及国际刑事法院、美以关系以及国际法执行边界。
items.why_it_matters_en: This involves the ICC, US-Israel relations, and the limits of international law enforcement.

items.title: 阿根廷总统称巴西总统为“小偷”和“罪犯”
items.original_title: Argentine leader calls Brazilian president a 'thief' and a 'convict'
items.summary_zh: 哈维尔·米莱在支持右翼总统候选人弗拉维奥·博索纳罗的竞选集会上发言，直言不讳地抨击巴西现任总统卢拉。
items.summary_en: Javier Milei spoke at a campaign rally for right-wing presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who is running against Lula, calling the Brazilian president a 'thief' and a 'convict'.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 南美两大经济体领导人之间的紧张关系可能影响区域合作与贸易。
items.why_it_matters_en: Tensions between leaders of South America's two largest economies could affect regional cooperation and trade.

items.title: 以色列定居者在西岸纵火焚烧清真寺和农田
items.original_title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say
items.summary_zh: 此次袭击发生在前两天巴勒斯坦人与定居者冲突导致4名巴勒斯坦人和2名以色列人丧生之后。
items.summary_en: The latest attacks come two days after a clash between settlers and Palestinians near the village of Tal, which left four Palestinians and two Israelis dead.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 西岸暴力升级可能破坏地区稳定并引发更多国际关注。
items.why_it_matters_en: Escalating violence in the West Bank threatens regional stability and may draw increased international attention.

items.title: 乌克兰袭击克里米亚导致城镇断水断电
items.original_title: Ukrainian Attacks in Crimea Deprive Towns of Power and Water
items.summary_zh: 乌克兰旨在将战争带回普通俄罗斯人生活的行动，意在施压克里姆林宫进行谈判。莫斯科方面则表现得若无其事。
items.summary_en: Ukraine’s campaign to bring the war home to ordinary Russians is meant to pressure the Kremlin to negotiate. Moscow has acted as if there were no crisis.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 乌克兰对克里米亚的持续打击正在改变战争的性质和俄罗斯国内舆论。
items.why_it_matters_en: Ukraine's sustained strikes on Crimea are changing the nature of the war and Russian domestic opinion.

items.title: 中国工业企业利润增速创年内新低
items.summary_zh: 官方数据显示，中国6月份工业企业利润增长放缓至今年以来的最低增速，并突显出不同行业企业盈利的复苏并不均衡。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 作为中国经济的重要风向标，工业企业利润增速放缓可能预示着经济复苏动力减弱。

items.title: Shein因特朗普关税拖累，亏损9900万美元
items.original_title: Shein swings to $99m loss as Trump tariffs hit sales
items.summary_zh: 快时尚巨头希音宣布亏损9900万美元，受特朗普关税影响销售下滑。该公司正准备在香港上市。
items.summary_en: The fast fashion giant Shein reported a $99 million loss as Trump tariffs hit sales. The company is preparing for its stock market debut in Hong Kong.
items.why_it_matters_zh: Shein的亏损反映全球贸易摩擦对跨境电商和中国供应链的冲击。
items.why_it_matters_en: Shein's loss reflects the impact of global trade friction on cross-border e-commerce and Chinese supply chains.

items.title: 大众汽车大幅下调年度营收预期
items.summary_zh: 大众汽车大幅下调年度营收预期，给CEO奥博穆带来巨大压力，迫使其推进包括创纪录规模裁员在内的新一轮成本削减措施。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 作为全球最大汽车制造商之一，大众的困境反映了欧洲制造业面临的成本压力和转型挑战。

items.title: 欧洲天然气价格再次逼近伊战初期高点
items.summary_zh: 基准价格在过去一个月飙升近50%。热浪肆虐加上对入冬前储气目标的担忧，令市场对霍尔木兹海峡再次关闭格外敏感。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 欧洲能源价格持续攀升将加剧通胀压力并影响居民生活和企业生产。

items.title: 中国芯片股首日暴涨近470%，AI需求驱动
items.original_title: Chinese chipmaker shares surge nearly 470% in blockbuster stock market debut
items.summary_zh: 某中国芯片公司股价在上市首日飙升近470%，AI热潮推动芯片需求。
items.summary_en: The company's shares soared by nearly 470% in its market debut, as the AI boom drives chip demand.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该涨幅显示市场对中国半导体自主化和AI发展的强烈预期。
items.why_it_matters_en: The surge shows strong market expectations for China's semiconductor self-sufficiency and AI development.

items.title: 英伟达与微软等数十家企业成立开放AI安全联盟
items.original_title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance – without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
items.summary_zh: 英伟达、微软、IBM等科技公司成立开放安全AI联盟，旨在构建和共享开源AI安全工具。OpenAI、谷歌和Anthropic未加入。
items.summary_en: Nvidia, Microsoft, and other tech companies announced the Open Secure AI Alliance to build and share open-source AI security tools. OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic are not included.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该联盟可能改变AI安全领域的竞争格局，尤其是围绕开源与闭源路线的分化。
items.why_it_matters_en: The alliance could reshape the AI security landscape, especially the divide between open-source and closed-source approaches.

items.title: Anthropic发布Claude Opus 5，能力接近Fable 5
items.original_title: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
items.summary_zh: Anthropic推出新模型Opus 5，称其在许多领域接近更强大的Fable 5，但价格只有一半。
items.summary_en: Anthropic released its newest model, Claude Opus 5, which comes close to the capabilities of Fable 5 in many domains at half the price.
items.why_it_matters_zh: Opus 5的发布加剧了AI大模型的价格战，并推动着AI民主化。
items.why_it_matters_en: The release of Opus 5 intensifies the price war among AI large models and promotes democratization of AI.

items.title: Meta升级AI聊天机器人，更像智能助手
items.original_title: Meta is making its AI chatbot more like an assistant
items.summary_zh: Meta AI升级，新增日历集成、每日简报和深度研究功能，以与Gemini、ChatGPT竞争。
items.summary_en: Meta is upgrading its AI chatbot with new productivity features including calendar integration, daily briefings, and in-depth research, to compete with rivals like Gemini and ChatGPT.
items.why_it_matters_zh: Meta对AI助手的押注显示了科技巨头在AI个人助理领域的激烈竞争。
items.why_it_matters_en: Meta's bet on AI assistant shows the fierce competition among tech giants in the AI personal assistant space.

items.title: DeepSeek被曝主动叫停了第二轮融资签约
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek被曝主动叫停第二轮融资签约，该轮融资计划至少募资100亿元。
items.why_it_matters_zh: DeepSeek作为国内AI明星公司，其融资动态反映出AI行业资本市场的态度变化。

items.title: 蚂蚁百灵发布新一代原生混合推理模型Ling-3.0-Flash
items.summary_zh: 蚂蚁集团旗下百灵发布新一代原生混合推理模型Ling-3.0-Flash，提升推理效率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 蚂蚁集团持续加码AI大模型，显示金融科技巨头对AI核心技术的投入。

items.title: 希音（SHEIN）披露聆讯后资料集：2025年营收418亿美元
items.summary_zh: 希音向港交所披露聆讯后资料集。2025年实现营收418亿美元，净利润20.6亿美元，平台服务约2.73亿活跃客户。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 希音港股IPO是2026年最大的跨境电商IPO，反映中国出海企业的资本化进程。

items.title: 小鹏将于未来6个月在澳大利亚推出5款新车型
items.summary_zh: 小鹏在墨尔本举办发布会，宣布未来6个月将在澳大利亚推出5款全新车型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 中国新势力车企加速出海，澳大利亚成为重要海外市场。

items.title: 比亚迪以1200万港元中标香港一幅用地，用作电动车充电站
items.summary_zh: 香港地政总署公布，比亚迪以1200万港元中标九龙晓光街用地，批租期12年，将用作电动车充电站。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 比亚迪加快在港充电基础设施布局，支持其电动车全球化战略。

items.title: 出海企业苦等的可信任AI营销产品，飞书深诺做出来了
items.summary_zh: 飞书深诺推出可信任AI营销产品，旨在帮助中国品牌在全球实现营销效果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: AI营销工具成为中国出海企业提升海外竞争力的关键基础设施。
